description: The monadic validity procedure returns true exactly when every nonempty model satisfies its input sentence.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideValidity_correct {k : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Sentence) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.decideValidity φ = true ↔
    ∀ (M : Type) (x : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.MonadicLogic.lang k).Structure M), Nonempty M → M ⊨ φ
